body.message:
Great timing on the 30th, the studio in Binghatti Azure is available and that move-in date works perfectly.

Minimum stay is 1 month, no traditional 30-day notice needed, you just confirm your extension 10 days before the month ends. Early checkout: once payment's made it's non-refundable, so just give 7 days notice if you decide to leave. And yes, a contract gets issued in your name.

Want to send over your passport copy so we can get the details confirmed for Tuesday?
